verdict: Organic presence holding; paid is paused and CRM work is overdue.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, paid advertising recorded zero spend and zero leads — campaigns are paused while CRM and outreach groundwork is being completed. Google Business Profile was the only source of inbound activity, delivering a combined 395 actions (23 calls, 254 direction requests, and 118 website clicks) across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision in the last 28 days. GBP momentum has softened in the most recent week — down at Advance Grinding and O'Hare Precision, and stalling at Forte Metals — so profile optimisation is being prioritised to stabilise that signal before paid campaigns resume. Three CRM milestones from July remain open; closing those is the prerequisite for paid reactivation and automated follow-up, and that work is actively in progress with a target of end of August.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all locations in the last 28 days — calls, direction requests, and website clicks
GBP actions at Advance Grinding this period, the highest single-location count, though down 55% in the most recent week
paid ad spend across Meta and Google Ads at every location for the full 28-day window

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement is declining week-over-week at two of three locations, and paid campaigns remain off — inbound activity has no backup source right now.
watch_item.fix: Profile optimisation is underway to arrest the GBP decline, and CRM data clean-up is on track for end of August so paid campaigns can reactivate with clean audience and tracking foundations.
